subject: Waterway information - North Coast
text:
Waterway information - North Coast
The Canadian Coast Guard is asking mariners to observe, record and report any sightings of oil in Grenville Channel
vicinity of 53 31.22N 129 34.55W.
Send reports to the CCG Regional Operations Centre 1-800-889-8852 or by email ROC1COR1@dfo-mpo.gc.ca. 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1554-22
